name: xuanxing-study-todo
description: What the current user still has to study in 绚星 (Xuanxing) - assigned training projects, tasks a mentor arranged, and exams not yet taken or not yet passed. Use when the user asks 我这周有什么要学的 / 我还有什么没学完 / 我的培训 / 待办 / 导师给我派了什么 / 我还有哪些考试没考, or asks what is due or overdue. Do not use for finding new courses to enroll in - that is xuanxing-catalog-discovery.
